errorUnsupportedFileType.title: Unsupported file type

errorFileTooLarge.title: File too large
errorFileTooLarge.message: The file {fileName} exceeds the maximum allowed size of {maxSize} MB. Please upload a smaller file.

errorMultipleFiles.title: Multiple files selected
errorMultipleFiles.message: Please select only one file at a time.

successFileUploaded.title: File uploaded successfully
successFileUploaded.message: The file {fileName} has been uploaded successfully.

successFileNameUpdated.title: File name updated
successFileNameUpdated.message: The file name has been successfully changed.

errorInvalidCharacters.title: Invalid characters

errorEmptyName.title: Empty name
errorEmptyName.message: The file name cannot be empty. Please enter a valid name.

infoSameName.title: No change
infoSameName.message: The file name is the same as before. No changes were made.

successFileCopiedToClipboard.title: File copied to clipboard
successFileCopiedToClipboard.message: The image has been successfully copied to the clipboard.
